visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit 7-Eleven convenience store. Two men, one wearing a long brown coat and the other a tan utility jacket, meet in front of a self-checkout kiosk and an 'ibon' machine. They are both holding the same brand of bottled coffee, looking surprised. The background features shelves of drinks and store signage. (2) The camera cuts to a medium close-up of the man in the brown coat. He is speaking with an animated expression, his eyes wide and mouth moving quickly. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a retail environment. In the background, posters and digital displays are visible. (3) A sequence of fast cuts follows, showing both men together. They are holding up bottles of 'Georgia' branded coffee, specifically the Cloud Latte variant. They are gesturing with their hands, pointing at the bottles and smiling broadly. The man in the tan jacket wears glasses and has short black hair. (4) The men are seen drinking the coffee simultaneously in a medium shot. They tilt their heads back, bottles to their lips. The environment remains the same convenience store interior. Yellow price tags and promotional stacks of coffee boxes are visible behind them on the floor. (5) They stand side-by-side, holding their bottles toward the camera. The man on the left makes a peace sign with his fingers while pointing to his bottle. They are positioned in front of a digital kiosk. The lighting is consistent studio-style indoor light. (6) The final phase shows the two men walking away from the camera toward the store's refrigerated section. The man in the brown coat has his arm around the other man's shoulder. The store aisles are filled with colorful packaged goods, and the overall atmosphere is energetic and casual.
